internship.name: MANUU Connect Internship
internship.description: 6-month intensive program with mentorship, real projects, and industry exposure.

referrals.name: Get Referrals
referrals.description: Leverage the MANUU Connect network and mentorship for job opportunities.

joining.question: Who can join MANUU Connect?
joining.answer: Any CS/IT student enrolled at MANUU can join. The platform welcomes both beginners and experienced students.

cost.question: Does it cost anything to participate?
cost.answer: No. Participation in MANUU Connect activities, including hackathons, workshops, and other events, is completely free for students.

hackathons.question: What is the typical team size for hackathons?
hackathons.answer: Teams generally consist of 2 to 4 members. Some events may allow solo participation, so students should check the rules for the specific event.

projects.question: Can I submit projects I've already worked on?
projects.answer: Yes. Students can submit previous projects if they are relevant to the event or challenge. They should clearly mention any prior work done on the project.

remote_participation.question: Can I participate remotely?
remote_participation.answer: Some events allow remote participation. Students should check the individual event guidelines for eligibility and virtual participation instructions.

resources.question: Are resources provided for projects?
resources.answer: Yes. For hardware-based events, basic toolkits and components are provided. For software projects, necessary APIs, platforms, or cloud resources are made available when needed.

support.question: How can I get support or ask questions?
support.answer: Students can reach out through the platform's contact form, email, or WhatsApp channel. The community provides guidance, support, and mentorship.
